About Us

Your Comfort Stop on
Shrirampur–Newasa Road

Hotel Sai Pratik & Lodging is a trusted name in Newasa BK, offering clean comfortable rooms and a popular Veg & Non-Veg restaurant. Conveniently located on the main Shrirampur–Newasa highway with ample parking space for cars and trucks.
